claims.statement: The scaffold refreshes 33 direct dependencies to their latest in-range versions and migrates vitest and @vitest/coverage-v8 from 3.2.7 to 5.0.3, which clears GHSA-82fw-gwwq-j7x9 (fixed only at >=4.1.11 and therefore unreachable in range). vitest 5 peers vite ^6.4.0 || ^7 || ^8, so the existing vite ^6.4.3 override is unchanged. vitest.config.ts drops a UserConfig plugins cast that vitest 5 makes unnecessary; that export is also renamed to ViteUserConfig in 5, and type-check passes with the plugins array declared plainly. Full-tree advisories fall from 31 to 2; the two that remain are dev-path with no safe fix (braces 3.0.3 is both latest and vulnerable; the old esbuild arrives through the deprecated @esbuild-kit chain under drizzle-kit). bun audit --prod reports no vulnerabilities. This receipt binds only these three changed paths at the subject commit. It grants no merge, admission, runtime, or fleet-rollout authority and establishes no owner review.
